controls: Implement actual touch/pointer input with per-finger ownership and capture/fallback; no fake keyboard or mouse control underneath mobile gestures. Detect coarse/touch capabilities with suitable explicit input-mode fallback. Centralize game actions so existing physics/combat are shared.

Left analog movement stick with dead zone and proportional walking; choose a discoverable two-thumb sprint affordance. Preserve analog magnitude for walking but normalize a nonzero dash direction so a small stick tilt does not shorten Soul Shift or weaken its interruption dot test.

Right drag-look zone plus a hold-fire button that also supports drag aiming with the same finger. Walking, looking and firing must work with just two thumbs. An ADS toggle, reload, dash, jump/vault, crouch, weapon swap, hold-recover/service, map, pause/resume and restart/anchor must all be touch reachable.

Hold-use may start outside reach and begin recovery on entering the real ring, just as held E does. Keep original2.8m/.9s recovery and service interruption rules. Do not add autoaim, damage/resource boosts, automatic mission completion or hidden difficulty changes.

No mouse pointer-lock request in touch mode. Preserve per-finger pointer capture, prevent compatibility-mouse duplicate fire/actions, and keep menus tappable. Clear movement/fire/aim/use and gesture ownership on pause/map/dialog/background/blur/visibility/context loss/orientation/resize/end/restart/anchor. Held old fingers cannot reactivate controls after resume without a new down.

Viewport-normalized touch look sensitivity, independent accessible setting if needed, stable ADS feel and no camera jump on initial touch or resize. Tune mobile FOV/viewmodel size if useful for acquisition, but verify reticle/rays/ADS/weapon framing and document visual changes.
layout: Mobile gameplay first, landscape recommended with a usable portrait fallback and responsive menus/map/end/dialogs. Cover844x390,667x375 and390x844 CSS viewports at highDPR, plus an Android-wide phone. Use100dvh, viewport-fit=cover and safe-area padding; never require fullscreen/orientation-lock APIs to play.

Readable restrained phone HUD with44px-or-larger actual touch targets and separation. Keep central aim/combat view open; reduce oversized radar/cards/announcements, hide keyboard-only hints in touch mode and provide short touch instructions. No overlapping buttons or offscreen critical content.

Reserve visible stick/button/HUD rectangles in marker composition, not the whole invisible look zone/container. Preserve truthful target/receiver visibility. Facility route selection and close/pause/settings controls must work by tap and support scrolling where needed.
Browser scrolling/zoom gestures should not steal active gameplay contacts; ordinary menus/dialog scrolling must remain usable. Avoid disabling zoom globally as an input workaround.
rendering: Define a touch/mobile rendering profile before expensive renderer/world allocation. Default to bounded render scale and no expensive shadow map, lower rain/effect/light cost where justified; preserve collision, shelter and all combat/mission simulation rules. Respect explicit quality choice and provide recoverable settings.

Current balanced canvas uses1.5DPR (2.25CSS pixel count),1700rain lines and2048shadow map. Measure before/after canvas pixels, active rain/lights/shadow and actual render calls. These are budgets/emulated measurements, not evidence of physical-phone FPS or thermal performance.

Avoid large fallback parsing on normal asset loads, needless per-frame allocation and redraw when paused/backgrounded. Preserve material/geometry ownership and original Blender assets. Do not lower simulation frequency or damage to hide slow rendering.

The shipped dossier should avoid eagerly loading its thousands of historical images on phones. A documented output-only lazy-image transform is allowed while keeping historical source sections byte-identical. Tests should check visible lazy images and resource existence, not require every offscreen image decoded.
mobileOnlyTesting: All new game playtests, smoke and production gameplay checks use mobile contexts/touch input. Pure logic/geometry unit checks may run without a device. Do not run old desktop keyboard mission/smoke and rename it a mobile test. Make default test/test:production mobile suites; retain historical desktop sources/evidence without rerunning their playtests.

Build a visible-only mobile ordinary driver (e.g.tools/mobile-playtest.mjs) with native CDP touch contacts, touch taps/joystick/swipes/hold-fire/drag-look, mobile UA/isMobile/hasTouch/DPR and CSS-coordinate metadata. No keyboard/mouse/eval/game-handle command. Selector geometry/visible UI only. Default ordinary two-thumb contact limit, clear API/help, actual mobile taps to pause/resume, real cleanup/owned-PID lock.

Parent transport proof build73-parent-touch-transport.json uses native trusted touch/pointer events on mobile scratch UI. In installed Chrome156.0.8078.76 partial touchEnd lists the ENDED contact (not remaining contacts); empty touchEnd releases all. Initial wrong-contact fixture is retained. Unit-test this version-specific behavior before using driver so releasing fire does not cancel movement. Start/move may include active contacts; verify ownership and all releases. Do not mistake Chrome transport for physical-device support.

Test simultaneous move+look+fire, independent contact release/cancel/lost capture, fire dragging out of button, compatibility events, ADS/reload/swap, sprint/dash direction, hold-use, map/pause/modal/orientation/background/reset/anchor cleanup and no scroll or pointer lock. Include actual geometry/ray/health/ammo/progress effects, not source-string assertions.

New mobile production checks include touch deployment, real movement/aim/fire/reload/dash/vault or jump/crouch/use/map/settings/end/retry, actual GLB/fallback and error health, normal URL isolation, safe layout across phone sizes/orientations and working source/shipped dossier resources.

A fresh privileged touch-only mission controller must actually finish three recoveries, boss and upload with no errors using normal resources and real touch controls. It may read exact internals for decisions, but no teleport/boost/simulation advance or direct action calls. Keep arranged unit fixtures separate from ordinary results.
